title: Will AI replace admin jobs in the UK? The role is narrowing, not vanishing
dek: UK employers are already using AI for scheduling, notes, drafting and records. The evidence points to fewer routine tasks and tighter recruitment, but also to a continuing need for people who manage exceptions, relationships, quality and accountability.

title: AI can draft the minutes. Administrators still own the record
dek: AI minute-takers are moving into real UK public-sector workflows. They can reduce transcription and drafting work, but the human role now centres on notification, judgement, accuracy, records management and accountability.

title: AEO tools are going mainstream. Here is what UK marketers should measure
dek: AI search visibility platforms can now track prompts, mentions and citations at scale. The useful question is not whether to buy one, but how to separate directional signals from vanity metrics and connect the work to real business outcomes.

title: AI Is Redesigning Admin Jobs Before Removing Them: What the Latest UK Evidence Shows
dek: Administrative work is among the first areas being changed by AI, but the strongest UK evidence points to tasks being reorganised more widely than jobs being eliminated.
